description: Scan a project's lockfile for dependency risks. Parses package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, Gemfile.lock, pubspec.lock, or Pipfile.lock and batch-queries OSV for vulnerabilities across all dependencies.

lockfile_content.description: Full text content of the lockfile

lockfile_name.description: Filename to determine format: package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, Gemfile.lock, pubspec.lock, Pipfile.lock

name: hound_audit
